name: WireGuard VPN (wg-easy)
summary: Your own WireGuard VPN server with a web UI to add devices and scan QR codes, admin account preconfigured.
notes: Official wg-easy 15.4.0 image pinned by tag and digest. The admin account, endpoint host and port are created at first start with the unattended INIT_* variables, so the web UI is never left open to a first visitor. The UI is only reachable through Caddy over HTTPS; WireGuard listens on UDP 51820. Without a domain the UI is served with a self-signed certificate for the IP address and clients connect to the IP.
